title: Write-tool diff preview counts a phantom trailing blank line, off-by-one in '… +N more lines'
observed: 40-line write's capped diff preview (lines 1-12 shown, cap=12) reads '… +29 more lines' (01-write-prompt-capped.txt), when the file only has 40 lines total (40-12=28 lines actually hidden).
expected: Hidden-line count should equal 28 ('… +28 more lines'), matching the actual remaining line count.
design_ref: internal/tui/permission_render.go:427-434 diffHunksFromWriteArgs: strings.Split(content, "\n") on write content that ends with a trailing newline (YAML 'content: |' block scalar keeps one trailing \n) yields a 41st empty-string element, inflating hunkLines by one; already flagged in the function's own doc comment as 'defect 2'
